items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: And on my father's side, Jasper Hug, my uncle played drums.

ctx.x: I never could get that story.

I don't know. I better not make that statement because I'm not sure. But it seemed that I'd heard that. Frankie came to a sudden end. He died quite young. And I guess that probably was the reason why he may not have gone. I'm not sure about that. But that was the connection of my grandfather and the Christian family. And on my father's side, Jasper Hug, my uncle played drums. He played around in the old Waterville shows in town, the old suburban houses. And, well, my uncle was a Waterville entertainer. He played…
What was your uncle's name then?
